name: AUDIT-C
source: WHO (Bush et al., 1998). Free to use.
note: PROVISIONAL, for the reviewer (D-36). The cut-off is 5 or more, for everyone, from THL's own AUDIT-C form, the national source: THL prints women 5+, men 6+, over 65 4+. The app asks neither sex nor age over 65, so the lowest adult cut-off, 5, applies to everyone and in every language, so the same answers route the same way whatever the interface language. Previous value: 3 or more for everyone, from the published international cut-offs (>=4 men, >=3 women). The clinician owns this decision.
